reviews.t: It's the same one in China.
reviews.x: It looked exactly like the one used by my nail lady in China, a humble box with a black switch and little red timer button on top right corner, and a sliding plate for your hand. Hell, even the blue covering foil on the sliding plate looked exactly the same....  Needless to say, I'm happy, and surprised.  The lady used this one for years, so I'm looking forward to stick with this one.

I really don't have too much to say about this LED lamp, other than it works. It's definitely not built the best, nor the sturdiness, but it does cure led gel quickly and efficiently. A suitable lamp for personal, at home use.

Always want to have my nails done but with small baby it's not easy and never have time to go to the nail salon. So I decide to buy Makartt 35W Nail Dryer UV Lamp. Good quality product for responsible price. Easy to use! Work well with all types of gels. Have a timer. Product shipped at time in original box. I really recommend this product!

I absolutely love this curing Uv lamp. I expected it to be cheap to be honest as it cost much less than other sellers. However, not the case at all. It works well amd works fast. Be sure to cure your mails after each coat of polish amd you will have beautiful, perfectly dry nails within minutes. Couldn't be happier with this purchase. Sometimes you roll the dice and it pays off :) certainly worth it

reviews.t: I used this product for about 10 minutes and it ...
reviews.x: I used this product for about 10 minutes and it stopped working. It was affordable and seemed to work well but I didn't even get to finish one hand before it blew a fuse or something. Kinda depressing. Hopefully it was just a fluke.

I love this uv light! It was a great price and works perfectly! It cured my gel polish very fast and I love that I can fit my entire hand in it unlike some of the other cheaper uv lights. For the price I didn't expect it to be such a great quality and work so well but I was pleasantly surprised it was exactly what I was looking for! I highly recommend!!

As other reviewers have said, this is a really nice lamp. Cures my gel layers in 4 min. Lots of room so you aren't bumping your nails. Large enough for toes. Only problem, like others have said the timer doesn't work. I used the stopwatch on my phone.  Other than that works great.
Very nice! So much larger than expected. Thank you!

reviews.t: Bought for use with UV Resin
reviews.x: I didn't buy this for nails, but for curing UV Resin. And it works like a charm. I'm using resin from the Sophie & Toffee brand at the moment, and I leave it in for roughly 10min each cure. It's given me consistent hard cures each time.  The lamp is really lightweight and isn't any heavy duty plastic but if you're a bit careful and don't drop it, drop things on it, throw it, or otherwise abuse it I don't think it's a problem. It is a little big but nothing extreme, and in the case of resin work
Works fine. Not the best quality. My main issue is it's a bit bulky and takes up lots of space. Also, I think 16.00+ is a bit high for its quality. I don't think I would recommend.

I am amazed at how fast this works.  My daughter has been using this for a couple days now and is loving it.  She paints her nails with the gel paint and then she places her hand under the light and withing a few seconds it is dry.  This is a quality curing lamp that works very quickly.  Anyone who is going to use gel polish on a regular basis would benfit from this curing lamp.  It is efficent and does the job like a professional.  I am very impressed. I chose to write this review. reviews.x: Item came on time. Packaging was good. When I plugged it in, I noticed a bulb wasn't working. Switched bulbs to different ports and the bulb worked but other didn't. Light bulbs were good but figured out one of the light ports is defective!!! Such a disappointment!!  Update!!!! I was contacted by the seller regarding my review and the product. Delivery was quick. Product not so great,no instructions. Didn't cure my gel nails after ten minutes they were still sticky. A blow dryer would do a better job. Price wasn't too bad but I guess I got what I paid for. It's 36 watts of what? I bought a 9watt mini uv gel nail lamp and it does the job compared to the huge dinosaur of a lamp that did nothing..... I want my money back and them to replace it with a product that will work like it says....
No instructions, or I would give it a better review.  What I have finally worked out is to wipe my nails with rubbing alcohol AFTERWARDS to remove the stickiness.

I didn't really think about UV radiation when buying this. When I used it, I noticed a tingly itch forming on the upper part of my hand. Kinda terrifies me so I put it in my closet because my sister didn't want me throwing it out. It didn't even cure my nails either but I'm not sure if that was because of the nail polish I was using. But I clicked the red button about 5-6 times because it was still sticky, So I might have skin damage now. Hopefully not cancer

claims.text: Most reviewers say the lamp cures gel polish quickly and works well, often exceeding expectations for the price.
Several reviewers praise the large size, noting it fits an entire hand and even toes comfortably.
A few reviewers complain about build quality and sturdiness, with some calling it bulky or overpriced.
Some reviewers report problems with the timer not working or a defective light port.
A few reviewers mention missing instructions or the lamp failing to cure nails, with one unit stopping working almost immediately.
